title: Transaction
description: A bank-account-to-bank-account movement of money. May or may not be linked to a Payment/Invoice (e.g. a fund-forwarding hop between shell accounts has no invoice behind it). This is the edge type the money-flow graph traverses. See docs/contracts/domain.md and research/graph/README.md.

booked_at.description: Optional timestamp for temporal detectors. When null, detectors use noon UTC on transaction_date.
